# Setup

```{r Package Imports, message = F, warning = F}
# Warnings and startup messages suppressed
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)
library(ggpmisc)
```

```{r}
OME <- read_csv(here("Manuscript_Plots", "OCNMS_final_Data", "18Sv4_eDNAxEnvData.csv")) %>%
  filter(diss_oxygen != "missing: not collected" & temp != "missing: not collected") %>%
  mutate(source = "Mooring?") %>%
  mutate(DateMatch = round_date(eventDate, unit = "hour"))
model_37m <- read_csv(here("Manuscript_Plots", "LiveOcean_TH042_2021_2023_DepthClean_2.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(DateMatch = Date_UTC) %>% # this is the one I'm actually using
  mutate(source = "Model")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = OME, aes(x = eventDate, y = as.numeric(diss_oxygen))) +
  geom_line(color = "navyblue", size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = model_37m, aes(x = Date_UTC, y = as.numeric(Oxygen_mg_L)),
            color = "orange", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "TH042 Mooring vs. LiveOcean Model (DO)", caption = "Model in orange, mooring(?) in dark blue. 37m depth.") +
  theme_bw() 

ggsave(here("LiveOcean_Plots_37", "Mooring_vs_Model_DO_37.png"))

ggplot(data = OME, aes(x = eventDate, y = as.numeric(temp))) +
  geom_line(color = "navyblue", size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = model_37m, aes(x = Date_UTC, y = as.numeric(Temp_C)),
            color = "orange", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "TH042 Mooring vs. LiveOcean Model (Temp)", caption = "Model in orange, mooring(?) in dark blue. 37m depth.") +
  theme_bw() 

ggsave(here("LiveOcean_Plots_37", "Mooring_vs_Model_Temp_37.png"))
```

## Regression

```{r, eval = F}
# Not currently working because it's old code
compare <- left_join(OME, model_37m, by = join_by(Date_UTC))
  
  # Compare temp predictions
  temp_mod <- lm(as.numeric(Temp_C) ~ as.numeric(temp), compare)
  #print(summary(temp_mod))
  rsq <- summary(temp_mod)$r.squared
  print(paste("Temp R squared: ", rsq))
  t_RMSE <- sqrt(mean(temp_mod$residuals^2))
  t_bias <- mean(temp_mod$residuals)

  print(ggplot(compare, aes(x = as.numeric(temp), y = as.numeric(Temp_C))) +
          geom_point() +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
          ggtitle("Temperature at 37 m") +
          annotate("text", x = 9, y = 12, 
                   label = paste("R^2 = ", round(rsq, 3)), size = 10) +
          annotate("text", x = 9, y = 11, 
                   label = paste("RMSE = ", round(t_RMSE, 3)), size = 10) +
          theme_bw())
  
  ggsave("Temp_LiveOcean_37.png", 
         path = here("LiveOcean_Plots_37"),
         width = 3000, height = 2500, units = "px")
  
  # Compare DO predictions
  ox_mod <- lm(as.numeric(Oxygen_mg_L) ~ as.numeric(diss_oxygen), compare)
  #print(summary(ox_mod))
  o_rsq <- summary(ox_mod)$r.squared
  o_RMSE <- sqrt(mean(ox_mod$residuals^2))
  print(paste("DO R squared: ", o_rsq))

  print(ggplot(compare, aes(x = as.numeric(diss_oxygen), y = as.numeric(Oxygen_mg_L))) +
          geom_point() +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
          ggtitle("Oxygen at 37 m") +
          annotate("text", x = 7, y = 1, 
                   label = paste("R^2 = ", round(o_rsq, 3)), size = 10) +
          annotate("text", x = 7, y = 0.5, 
                   label = paste("RMSE = ", round(o_RMSE, 3)), size = 10) +
          theme_bw())
  
  ggsave(filename = "Oxygen_LiveOcean_37.png", 
         path = here("LiveOcean_Plots_37"),
         width = 3000, height = 2500, units = "px")
  

```
